Job Title: Associate Quality Analyst – Histology Analyst II Job Description The Associate Quality Analyst (Histology Analyst II) performs and documents complex histological testing in support of Quality, R&D, Clinical, Complaints, and Tissue Services functions. This role covers all phases of tissue preparation for paraffin and frozen techniques, including routine H&E staining, special stains (histochemistry), immunohistochemistry, microscopy, and image analysis. The analyst serves as a key quality gate for product release, maintains and qualifies histology equipment, updates documentation, supports audits and inspections, and trains peers and technicians. This position offers opportunities to learn and develop advanced techniques such as in-situ hybridization, electron microscopy, bone histology, method and process validation, and Lean/Six Sigma principles. Responsibilities Act as the final quality check on products prior to release by proficiently performing histology analysis and evaluating stain results to determine whether findings are due to histological processing or production processes. Exercise discretion to fail product when appropriate and initiate, report, and investigate out-of-specification (OOS) results through the Quality Management System. Evaluate R&D, clinical, donor, and control tissue samples as requested, ensuring accurate and timely histological assessment.
